doc: One-time hints (FirstTimeHint): a single line shown the first time a thing matters, then never again on that save (Save.d.tutorial.hints). They took over the tutorial steps that were cut (owner, Nov 8: shorter tutorials). {action} shows that action's key ({dash}, {crouch}, {interact}...), {rank} the rank-up keys, {boki} the active Boki's name. match: shown in a match by MatchHints; expedition: the same, but never in the tutorial match or the Training Grounds, and a save that finished the old tutorials still gets them (they are not cut steps); farm: on the farm by FarmHints; bond: the first Fuse (the key when the bond is full, the rest timer when it ends), by MatchHints. fight_quiet_s: no hint in the first seconds of a fight; one hint line on screen at a time (the next waits for the lane); sight_m: an outpost this close means no go-to-exit hint. blight_m: the edge of the Blight's closing ring this close (m) brings the Blight hint. A save that had finished the old tutorials sees none of its part (the v12 -> v13 migration).

match.exdash: Too far? Jump, then press {dash} in mid-air
match.crouch: Hold {crouch} to crouch and see farther
match.pickup: Gear! Walk over it to pick it up
match.orders: Tap {throw} to call {boki} back. Hold it for orders
match.rank: Skill point! Press {rank} to rank it up
match.key: A key! Hold {interact} at a chest to open it
match.uplink: Stand in the outpost's circle to start the uplink
match.defend: Stay in the circle until the lift opens
match.goexit: Outposts get you off the island. Look for one

expedition.blight: The Blight is closing. Move toward the Heart.
expedition.camp: Monsters give XP. Hits on Hunters build armour.
expedition.deathbox: A fallen Hunter's deathbox: press {interact} to take their gear

farm.stone: The house needs stone too: hold {interact} at a rock
farm.hammer: Hold {interact} at the house to hammer it up
farm.task: Click {boki} to give it a job
farm.buy: Out of seeds? Buy more at the Market
farm.sell: Sell crops at the Market for gems
farm.hob: Hob the builder is at the stall: press {interact} to talk

bond.fuse: Bond full! Press {ultimate} to Fuse with {boki}
bond.fuse_rest: {boki} rests a few seconds after a Fuse: its card counts it down

when.exdash: you are in the air over the void
when.crouch: a while into a match, standing on open ground
when.pickup: gear lies within a few metres
when.orders: your Boki is out fighting for the first time
when.rank: you have a skill point to spend
when.utility: a monster has been close for 2 s and you have not used your other ability
when.key: you pick up a chest key
when.uplink: you walk near an outpost that can start
when.defend: an uplink of yours is charging
when.goexit: a few minutes into a match with no outpost close
when.blight: the Blight's closing ring is within blight_m of you (or you are out in it)
when.camp: you (or your Boki) kill your first monster
when.deathbox: you stand at a deathbox you can loot
when.stone: the house is marked out and short of stone
when.task: the house stands and no Boki has a job
when.hob: the tutorial is over and you have not talked to Hob
when.fuse: your bond is full and the Fuse key would work (your first Fuse, ever)
when.fuse_rest: your first Fuse ends and your Boki lands to rest
